history_policy: Complete tracked source snapshot. Prior development history stays local because it previously included personal signing configuration.
autorenew: Portable source prepared from the locally verified macOS helper. Personal configuration, signing material, runtime logs and device evidence are excluded.
publication_scope: Source snapshot plus separately downloadable unsigned iOS sideload preview; no TestFlight or App Store publication.

binary_release.signing: unsigned; installer must re-sign using their own Apple account
binary_release.packaging: Existing verified device archive repackaged as Payload/Runner.app without changing App files.
